maddeler.e:
ننشغف (form VII)
# نَنْشَغِفُ (nanšaḡifu) /nan.ʃa.ɣi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
# نَنْشَغِفَ (nanšaḡifa) /nan.ʃa.ɣi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
# نَنْشَغِفْ (nanšaḡif) /nan.ʃa.ɣif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
